record.title: SEC security-based swap reporting and registered SDR route
record.sub: Report trades and retain regulatory records
kv: Exchange Act section 13(n), Regulation SBSR, and the SEC security-based-swap data-repository framework.
The instrument is a security-based swap subject to Regulation SBSR, rather than a CFTC swap or an ordinary tokenized security record.
DTCC Data Repository (U.S.), LLC · SEC security-based swap data repository (registered or chartered)
security-based swap dealer; major security-based swap participant; counterparty or platform assigned a reporting duty under Regulation SBSR; SEC-registered security-based swap data repository

Classify the instrument and responsible reporting person under the SEC regime. Confirm the registered SDR, asset class, reporting format, participant agreement, and compliance date applicable to the transaction. Do not merge the CFTC and SEC repository routes merely because service providers have related names.
This route does not govern ordinary securities-token recordkeeping, a transfer agent's master securityholder file, or CFTC-regulated swaps.

DTCC Data Repository (U.S.), LLC · SEC security-based swap data repository: SEC approved registration of DTCC Data Repository (U.S.), LLC as the first security-based swap data repository and stated its intended equity, credit, and interest-rate derivative asset classes.
